The Sizing Technology Pilot is a direct extension of this modernization mandate, seeking to apply advanced digital, computer vision, and AI-driven measurement extraction capabilities to a fundamental logistical process: Soldier and Cadet outfitting. The Army is exploring a Sizing Technology Pilot to modernize the Soldier and Cadet outfitting process by using body scanning, foot scanning, computer vision, and/or AI- driven measurement extraction to generate accurate measurements and translate them into recommended uniform and footwear sizing. This capability is intended to support personnel earlier in the accessions pipeline than is possible today, in support of a faster, more consistent, and more accurate issue experience. The scope of this requirement encompasses both body and foot scanning to modernize the issuance of both uniforms and footwear.
